test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Assiduous
solution:
The correct answer is Idle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Assiduous' is 'Idle'.
 
• Assiduous(adjective): working very hard and taking great care that everything is done as well as it can be
 
• Meaning of the given options:
 
 
• Belligerent(adjective)*: *unfriendly and aggressive
 
• Meticulous(adjective): giving or showing great attention to detail; very careful
 
• *Idle*(adjective)*: not wanting to work hard; lazy*
 
• Idyllic(adjective): very pleasant and peaceful; perfect
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.​
